summary: Robin Millican appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First.

mentions.section: The bill no state can shield
mentions.excerpt: Robin Millican, on Columbia Energy Exchange, which Jason Bordoff hosts with Bill Loveless, on June 30, named tariffs that make large loads pay their incremental grid costs as one of the structural fixes.
